text: We must be very happy together, and we must not seem to depend upon his forgiveness. And Morris, Morris, you must never despise me!” This was an easy promise to make, and Morris made it with fine effect. But for the moment he undertook nothing more onerous. XXVII THE Doctor, of course, on his return, had a good deal of talk with his sisters. He was at no great pains to narrate his travels or to communicate his impressions of distant lands to Mrs. Penniman, upon whom he contented himself with bestowing a memento of his enviable experience, in the shape of a velvet gown.
